title: VIXEN has no queued content-codegen check entrypoint
body: The brief-required bash tools/check-content-codegen.sh was invoked through the live queue from VIXEN and failed with exit 127 because the script is absent. The consumer should provide a checked-in queued content-codegen target or document the supported equivalent, so a lane does not need to discover a missing invocation manually.

title: UI kit tests depend on an undocumented executable working directory
body: The queued test_ui_kit executable failed from the repository root because its relative assets/ui/LatoLatin-Regular.ttf lookup returned null and the process exited 139. Running the same binary from build/wsl-debug/libraries/RenderGraph/tests passed. The test target should set its asset root or CTest working directory declaratively.

title: Generated view changes require manual consumer target rebuilds before GPU guards
body: After regenerating EditorLayers.g.h, the shared UI GPU guard initially ran stale test_panel_dock_documents and test_ui_input_forwarder binaries; eight tests failed because the old binders lacked the new fields. Rebuilding those targets explicitly through the queue made the exact guard pass 61/61. The generated-view dependency should force affected test/editor targets to rebuild before a guard.

title: AppFlow await_frame does not cover deferred OpenRecipe view publication
body: The windowed channel witness dispatched OpenRecipe and immediately read the view after await_frame(actionId), but OpenRecipe is intentionally applied in EditorApplication::Update; the read contained no layers. The witness needed an extra 30-frame settle after OpenRecipe and ReopenSaved. The channel contract should expose completion for deferred document mutations or provide a documented settle primitive.

title: Queued VIXEN build recovery needs a manual non-elastic credit cap
body: The initial queued target build was interrupted before producing a target result during resource contention; retrying the same target with --credits 1 completed. The live queue should preserve an admitted build or document the stable credit-capped route so recovery does not require lane-local queue tuning.
